name: [Deep Inside] Alizarin Red
source:
Good evening, everyone! It is my great pleasure and honor to welcome all of you to the Alizarin Red Exhibition. This year marks the 100th anniversary of the painter's death. Explore Gareth Leigh's masterpieces in the current exhibition, see his development as an artist and dive into his world.

[From [url=https://banya.itch.io/alizarinred]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
大家晚上好！非常高兴和荣幸地欢迎大家来到茜红展。今年是画家逝世100周年。在本次展览中探索加雷斯·利 (Gareth Leigh) 的杰作，了解他作为艺术家的发展并深入他的世界。

[来自[url=https://banya.itch.io/alizarinred]Itch.io[/url]]
